title: Complete, stably ordered SDDC LCM task collection retrieval
prompt:
Complete the SDDC and Fleet lifecycle task listing in sddclcm/client.go. The package is a dependency-free Go client for the VCF 9.1 SDDC LCM service; docs/contract.json is the local REST contract and docs/official_sources.json records where it came from. Preserve the exported API and the existing response types.

ListAllTasks must retrieve the getTasks collection completely: read pageMetadata.totalPages from the first page, then fetch the remaining pages with several requests in flight at once rather than one page at a time, bounded by ListTasksOptions.Concurrency. A Concurrency of 0 means 4, and any smaller value is raised to 2. A PageSize of 0 means 50, and every value is clamped to the range 1 to 50.

The returned slice must be in a stable order that does not depend on which page happened to complete first: ascending createTime, compared as instants so that a non-UTC offset sorts by the moment it denotes and not by its text; tasks whose createTime is absent or unparseable sort last; ties are broken by ascending id. Where one task id appears on more than one page, keep the occurrence with the lowest page number, and within a page the lowest index. Return an empty non-nil slice when the collection is empty, and return an error with no partial results when a page fails.

Every optional query parameter is optional on the wire: a filter the caller did not set must be left off the request entirely rather than sent with an empty value. A *bool set to false is set, not unset, so it must still be sent as includeSystemTasks=false. Timestamps keep the existing RFC3339 in UTC encoding. The same rule applies to getComponents, where an empty scope means the parameter is omitted.

Run python3 tests/verify.py. Only sddclcm/client.go is an implementation file; go.mod, docs/, internal/mockvcf/, sddclcm/client_test.go and tests/ are protected fixtures and must not be changed. The package must stay dependency-free.
